## 1. Summary

Implements a minimalist blog website from the Confluence user stories: users can register, log in, browse, search and sort all blogs, and create, edit, and delete their own posts. It is a server-rendered Flask app with SQLite storage, built through an 8-step agentic SDLC (requirements, architecture, design review, implementation plan, implementation, code review, verification, PR), with every step's artifact included in `artifacts/`.

## 2. Changes Made

All files are new unless marked modified.

**Application (`app/`)**
- `__init__.py` - app factory, error handlers (400/403/404/405/413/500), date filter, `SECRET_KEY` fail-fast outside debug.
- `config.py` - settings: 30-minute timeout, password 8-128, 64 KB request limit, cookie flags from env.
- `db.py` - per-request SQLite connection, `init-db` CLI command, UTC timestamp helper.
- `schema.sql` - `user` and `post` tables (case-insensitive unique username/email), `updated_at` index.
- `security.py` - session inactivity timeout, CSRF protection, security headers, `no-store` caching.
- `auth.py` - register, login, logout, keep-alive; hashed passwords; username/email lookup that cannot collide.
- `blog.py` - feed with search and sort (whitelisted), detail, create, edit, delete with author-only checks (403).
- `templates/` - `base.html`, `auth/{login,register}.html`, `blog/{index,detail,form,delete}.html`, `errors/error.html`.
- `static/style.css`, `static/app.js` - minimal styling; sort auto-submit and form-page session keep-alive.

**Project files**
- `run.py` - dev entry point (localhost, debug only via `FLASK_DEBUG`).
- `requirements.txt` - pinned Flask 3.1.3, Werkzeug 3.1.9, pytest 9.2.0, `click>=8.1`.
- `.gitignore` - excludes venv, caches, `instance/`, `*.db`, `.env`.
- `README.md` (modified) - setup, run, test, environment variables, limitations.

**Tests (`tests/`)** - `conftest.py`, `test_auth.py` (22), `test_blog.py` (29), `test_security.py` (14).

**SDLC artifacts (`artifacts/`)** - `requirements.md`, `architecture.md`, `design-review.md`, `impl-plan.md`, `code-review.md`, `verification.md`, `pr-description.md`.

## 3. Test Evidence

- **Automated:** `pytest -q` on Python 3.14.7 in a fresh venv: **65 passed, 0 failed** (16.8 s). All 29 acceptance criteria are covered by at least one test (traceability table in `artifacts/verification.md`).
- **Startup safety:** the app raises `RuntimeError` when `SECRET_KEY` is unset and debug is off.
- **Manual (run by the repository owner):** after setting `SECRET_KEY`, the app was started with `run.py` and registration, login, create, read, update and delete of blogs, search, and sort were all confirmed working in the browser.
- **Not verified:** the 5-minute keep-alive timer in `app.js` in a real browser, and Content-Security-Policy behavior in a real browser. Only Python 3.14 was tested.

## 4. Known Limitations

- No login rate limiting or account lockout.
- No pagination of the feed.
- Session cookies are signed, not server-tracked, so they cannot be revoked before expiry (including after logout, if a cookie was copied).
- No email verification, password reset, profile management, or account deletion (out of scope per requirements).
- Search and sort case-insensitivity covers ASCII letters only; usernames are limited to ASCII.
- Concurrent edits to the same post are last-write-wins.
- SQLite file storage; suited to small, single-server use.
- Assumptions from the requirements gaps (login required to view the feed, 8-character minimum password, 150-character snippets, title <= 150 and content <= 10,000 characters, etc.) are recorded in `artifacts/requirements.md` section 5 and were approved.
- Code review item CR-07 (leading whitespace on the first line of a post is trimmed) was left as-is.

## 6. Changelog Entry

### Added - Blog Website v0.1.0 (2026-10-29)

**Step 1 - Requirements.** Ingested 9 user stories (3 epics), 29 acceptance criteria, 5 non-functional requirements from Confluence; recorded 16 gaps with proposed defaults.

**Step 2 - Architecture.** Chose a Flask + SQLite server-rendered monolith; defined components, data model, 12 routes, security controls, and traceability.

**Step 3 - Design review.** Found 0 critical, 1 high (username/email collision), 8 medium, 6 low issues; required amendments carried to the plan.

**Step 4 - Implementation plan.** 15 dependency-ordered tasks (T-01 to T-15) incorporating the review amendments; test plan and definition of done.

**Step 5 - Implementation.** Wrote 27 source, template, static, config, and test files with no execution.

**Step 6 - Code review.** Static review found 0 high, 1 medium, 8 low issues; all requirements and design amendments confirmed implemented.

**Step 7 - Verification.** Applied review fixes (405 page, unknown-URL POST returns 404, search length cap, shared form helper, constant renames, random debug key, `click` dependency, 5 extra tests); 65/65 tests passed; manual run confirmed by the repository owner.

**Step 8 - PR.** This pull request: single commit of all accumulated code and artifacts.

### Security
- Salted password hashing, CSRF tokens on all POSTs, parameterized SQL, autoescaped output, CSP and related headers, `no-store` caching, 30-minute inactivity timeout, author-only edit/delete enforced server-side, request-size and password-length limits.
